title: Simple Standard Errors for Complicated (Quasi-)Experimental Designs
abstract: arXiv:2610.12674v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We develop standard errors for estimates of causal effects in settings where the distribution of treatment exposures is known but potentially exhibits complicated dependence patterns across units. Such dependence arises, for example, in settings with spillovers/interference across units or when the treatment assignment is spatially correlated. Our variance estimator generalizes several properties of the Neyman variance estimator for completely randomized experiments to general designs: it is unbiased for an upper bound on the variance from the design-based perspective; the conservativeness of this upper bound depends on the heterogeneity of treatment effects; and it is also valid under certain forms of super-population sampling of the potential outcomes. translated_title: 复杂（准）实验设计的简单标准误
translated_abstract: 我们针对处理暴露分布已知、但可能在单位之间呈现复杂依赖模式的情形，发展了因果效应估计的标准误。这种依赖性例如出现在单位间存在溢出效应/干扰的情形中，或当处理分配在空间上相关时。我们的方差估计量将完全随机实验中Neyman方差估计量的若干重要性质推广到了一般设计：从基于设计的视角看，它对方差的一个上界是无偏的；该上界的保守程度取决于处理效应的异质性；并且在潜在结果的某些超总体抽样形式下也依然有效。在简单设计中，我们的估计量可退化为标准方法，例如完全随机实验中的Neyman方差估计量，以及聚类设计中的聚类稳健方差估计量。
tldr: 提出一种适用于已知处理暴露分布但存在复杂依赖模式（如单位间溢出/干扰或空间相关处理分配）的方差估计量，它将Neyman方差估计量的关键性质推广到一般实验设计，并在简单设计下退化为标准方法。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a variance estimator for causal effect estimates when the treatment exposure distribution is known but exhibits complicated dependence across units, generalizing the key properties of the Neyman variance estimator to general designs while reducing to standard estimators in simple cases.
